name: uarch
description: uarch — runtime-free C++26 microarchitectural primitives and compile-time TMA layout/reflection contracts.

Provides header-only interface layers (uarch::primitives / uarch::freestanding, uarch::tiers, uarch::core, uarch::arch), the hosted umbrella (uarch::uarch), and the static CPUID/host capability detection library (uarch::detect).
Requires a C++26 reflection toolchain: GCC 16 with -freflection, or reflection-enabled Clang with libc++. Clang with libstdc++ is unsupported and fails the upstream reflection probe.
